verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents syncing Authenticator codes with the Password Manager vault, so tokens added or edited stay synchronized across Bitwarden apps. TOTP seeds stored in the vault by the integrated authenticator are generated client-side, and vault export/import and authenticator export/import give a backup and transfer route. Restoring on a new phone is strongly implied by vault sync but never spelled out as a lost-phone procedure. Missing for 10: an explicit documented lost-device/new-phone restore walkthrough, and independent hands-on confirmation that tokens reappear on a new device.
